name: Union Square Ventures
history: Union Square Ventures was founded in New York in 2003 by Fred Wilson and Brad Burnham, with a $125M first fund. It was an early backer of Twitter, Etsy, Tumblr, MongoDB, Twilio, Duolingo and Coinbase, and one of the first institutional investors in crypto. Its core funds are now $275M each, alongside a climate fund family started in 2021.
investment_concept: “We invest at the edge of large markets being transformed by technological and societal pressures.”

sources.note: the firm's own About page: the original early-stage fund (2004) was $125M; predates electronic Form D. Listed in the ADV 7.B roster only through its successors (the 2004 vehicle is fully realized).
